title: Milk Players
description: MilkPlayer is a fun 1.21.1 utility plugin that lets you milk other players! Just right-click a friend with an empty bucket to get a custom item named "Playername's Milk", complete with authentic sound effects and a smooth, bug-free experience.
body:
# 🥛 MilkPlayer
A lightweight and funny utility plugin for Paper servers that allows players to milk each other!

Have you ever looked at your fellow players and thought: "They look like they could provide some high-quality dairy"? Well, look no further! MilkPlayer brings the ultimate farming experience to the human (and humanoid) population of your Minecraft world.

## ✨ Features
**Player Milking:** Simply right-click another player with an empty Bucket to milk them.

**Custom Items:** Receive a "Player's Milk" bucket, named after the player you just milked.

**Immersive Sounds:** Features the classic cow milking sound effect for maximum realism.

**Performance Friendly:** Minimalistic code designed for high-performance servers.

## 🛠️ How it works
Craft or find an empty Bucket.

Sneak up (or just walk up) to your friend.

Right-click them.

Enjoy your fresh [PlayerName]'s Milk!

## 📥 Installation
Download the .jar file.

Drop it into your server's plugins folder.

Restart your server.

Start your new career as a player-dairy farmer!
